name: caelo
description: Free, local developer security scan for AI-built products. Finds exposed API keys, secrets leaked to the browser, and open databases. Reads files only, uploads nothing, redacts every secret it reports.
long_description: Caelo is a free, local developer security scanner for AI-built products. It flags common security leaks in project files: exposed API keys and secrets in source, Supabase service-role keys, secrets shipped to the browser behind a public prefix, open Firebase rules, permissive or missing Supabase row-level security, and committed .env files. It runs entirely on your machine, reads your files as data, never executes your code, and redacts every secret value it finds. Nothing is uploaded. A product of Irth Labs.

tools.name: roast_project
tools.description: Scan a project folder for exposed secrets and open databases, and return a graded report.
